verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs show it handles more than one prepaid rail. Tokenization covers Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards, a credit core manages the full credit-line lifecycle, and a Multi-app option combines two card types on one plastic. Nothing distinguishes commercial from consumer credit programs, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit commercial credit program support, explicit consumer credit program support, a dedicated page listing supported program types (debit/prepaid/credit), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail

citations.quote: nuestra solución de Tokenización está disponible para tarjetas Mastercard y Visa de crédito, débito o prepagas
Controla todo el ciclo de vida del crédito: desde la creación de la línea, pasando por la autorización de operaciones, hasta la cobranza y gestión de mora.
Es posible combinar dos tipos de tarjeta en un mismo plástico usando nuestra solución de Multi-app.
